answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 5652 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: My question is this that many people are sleeping in the Masjid, so i want to know is it Allowed to sleep in the Masjid or Not allowed ? Please send me the reply with the Refference. Shukriya! Question: Assalamu Alekum , My question is this that many people are sleeping in the Masjid, so i want to know is it Allowed to sleep in the Masjid or Not allowed ? Please send me the reply with the Refference. Shukriya! Answer ID: 5652 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 829/730=B/1429) A musafir and mu?takif (one who retires to a mosque with the intention of reward) can stay night in mosque. The other people should not use mosque like an inn, they should sleep in their houses. It is against the etiquettes of mosque for people to sleep there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
